digest.component_or_area: LLM completion verification and recovery workflow
propositions: completion.py and completion_recovery.py both exceed or reach 800 LOC module-size cap, blocking any further edits without extraction

completion.py conflates four distinct concerns: operation orchestration, child-closure gate, epic-close bug-screen, and verdict reconciliation; completion_recovery.py conflates criteria surface/admission/coverage, failure taxonomy, and recovery orchestration

behavioral decomposition requires moving concerns into separate modules (completion_child_gate, completion_reconcile, completion_criteria, completion_failures) while preserving public API contracts via re-exports from completion.py and completion_recovery.py
all moved symbols must remain patchable at their original dotted paths for test monkeypatch/patch targets and must be string-swept across codebase to catch orphaned references
refactored modules must each stay within 200-500 LOC bounds and pass existing test suites with zero assertion changes, only import-path and monkeypatch-target updates
